name: Frozen native covariate-aware TSFM
role: Generate quantile forecasts under one input policy
notes: Weights and checkpoint revisions remain unchanged

name: Finite logical policy generator
role: Create target-only all-dynamic single leave-one-out and correlation-top-k choices
output_format: ordered logical and deduplicated policy sets

name: Calibration historical-utility scorer
role: Estimate series-policy utility using only calibration losses
notes: Half-life three and target-only comparator inherited from P0c

name: Task-backbone applicability certificate
role: Enable dynamic routing only in groups passing point and lower-bound criteria
notes: Core contribution; exact 4-of-8 map is immutable

name: Positive-score dynamic router
role: Choose the highest positive scored available deduplicated policy
input_format: calibration-frozen scores plus current available policies
notes: Target-only score is zero and wins when no positive score exists

name: Calibration-best constant fallback
role: Abstain from dynamic routing in uncertified groups
notes: Also serves as the strongest constant comparator

name: Pre-outcome decision manifest
role: Hash every applicability fallback score and tie-break decision before loss inspection

name: Paired group-macro evaluator
role: Compare methods without Rossmann micro domination
output_format: group means confidence bounds and safety checks
notes: Equal weight over eight task-backbone groups
